scope: Read-only feasibility, no weights downloaded and no inference, training, cloud job or deployment launched by this audit.

environment.initial_sandbox_probe_note: /proc and /sys files were absent in restricted execution; an authorized read-only escalated probe obtained cgroup quotas.
environment.unrestricted_rlimit_note: Parent shell RLIMIT_AS and RLIMIT_CPU initially unlimited; proposed child guards do not change container quotas.

decision: Prefer official 4B Q8_0 over 8B Q5_K_M for lower memory and matching previous weight quantization family. Larger parameter count is not evidence of improved scoring or accuracy.

memory_estimate.formula: 2(K,V) * layers * context_tokens * kv_heads * head_dim * 34/32 bytes per q8_0 element
memory_estimate.limitations: Architectural nominal KV estimate excludes tensor alignment, runtime graph/workspace buffers, allocator overhead, executable/shared libraries, token/logit arrays, page cache and collector. Weight file size is a mapping estimate, not measured RSS or PSS. GGUF architecture must be checked at load.

proposed_runtime.compatibility: Expected from same qwen3 architecture already used with this runtime; this 4B asset has not been loaded or measured.
proposed_runtime.execution_design: Four short new-source diagnostic items, two fixed answer-label orders, exact prompt selection frozen before output. Use cache_prompt=false for each measured prompt. Do not reuse 8k-token previous prompts. Probe rendering/tokenization first, then one measured prompt as load/latency smoke; stop on memory/time/context/label-availability failure and preserve receipt. Continue remaining seven only if smoke fits predeclared resource limits.
proposed_runtime.memory_monitor: Capture cgroup memory.current, process RSS/PSS when available and child peak RSS; fail if cgroup reaches 7.5GiB or process exceeds guard. Do not raise guards in-place or silently change numerical settings.
proposed_runtime.statistics_scope: A bounded diagnostic tests execution and label-order behavior; eight outputs do not establish accuracy, general stability, calibration or inference advantage.

known_limitations: 8 GiB cgroup limit is shared; memory.current is only a snapshot and may rise.
No GPU tooling or NVIDIA device nodes were observed; this is not a complete hardware attestation.
Performance and fit estimates require an actual guarded smoke; no throughput or peak memory is measured here.
No guarantee that 4B removes yes/no presentation sensitivity or is a strong publication baseline.
Host libraries are not pinned by this feasibility audit; bind them in the actual execution receipt.
